data.Name: WIN Guide Vol. I
data.Description: A tattered field manual recovered from the wastes. Volume I covers basic survival: makeshift weapons, simple tools, and healing remedies. Study it carefully - each reading might inspire a useful idea. (Costs action, 50% chance to learn a blueprint)
data.2nd_state_Description: The advanced chapters of the field manual. Volume II covers intermediate crafting: reinforced weapons, potent remedies, and specialized tools. (Costs action, 50% chance to learn a blueprint)
